      public void gotResponseAtUpstream(byte[] rawResponse) throws Exception
      Description copied from interface: CmpRaComponent.CmpRaInterface
      application provides response received asynchronously from upstream. Must be called after returning null via CmpRaComponent.UpstreamExchange.sendReceiveMessage(byte[], String, int) when later receiving a delayed response from upstream.
      Specified by:
      gotResponseAtUpstream in interface CmpRaComponent.CmpRaInterface
      Parameters:
      rawResponse - ASN.1 DER-encoded response received from upstream
      Throws:
      Exception - on error not handled at CMP level

      public byte[] processRequest(byte[] rawRequest) throws Exception
      Description copied from interface: CmpRaComponent.CmpRaInterface
      used by application to provide CMP request from downstream to RA (which may be a poll request) and obtain the corresponding response.
      Specified by:
      processRequest in interface CmpRaComponent.CmpRaInterface
      Parameters:
      rawRequest - ASN.1 DER-encoded request

      the corresponding ASN.1 DER-encoded response (which may be a waiting indication or error) in due time: before timeout on downstream
